Title: Azure SQL Database accessible only through the Azure portal from July 1, 2017

Body.Content:
In 2015, we announced the general availability of the Azure portal. Beginning July 1, 2017, you will need to use the Azure portal to manage your Azure SQL databases instead of the Azure classic portal.

 

If you are not familiar with using the Azure portal for managing the Azure SQL Database service, you can get started by using these tutorials:

  • Design a SQL database
  • Secure your SQL database
  • Improve SQL database performance
  • Implement a multi-tenant application using SQL Database
  • Implement a geo-distributed database

If you have questions, please contact us.
